error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `view` still views it

  |
6 |     _ = mem.admit(storage, value) else zero
  |                   ^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/core-mem-used-live-admit/main.ldn:3:5

  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `store` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `view` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `store` without `inout`
